name: Kamio Seiji
source:
The eldest son of the Kamio family, whose father is the vice president of a major bank. Both the "family" and the company have high expectations of him. At the age of 35, he has been appointed as an executive officer, unhesitatingly achieving great results under pressure. He recognizes Kuze's abilities and has high hopes for him, but...
